name: Marksman's Reload
description: A chance to not consume ammo on a ranged attack.

name: Focused Aim
description: Landing a crit has a chance to build Focus, a stacking, decaying bonus to crit damage.

name: Opening Shot
description: Crits against a target still at full HP deal bonus flat damage.

name: Measured Distance
description: Bonus damage while attacking from range.

name: Fleet-Footed
description: Using a movement skill grants a brief technique and speed buff.

name: Running Advantage
description: Attacking from farther away deals more damage, scaling per tile of distance up to a cap.

name: Arcane Bulwark
description: Flat bonus to magic defense and max MP.

name: Warding Shroud
description: A portion of any damage taken is banked as temporary HP for a couple of turns, absorbing hits before anything else.

name: Spell Reflection
description: Toggleable. While on, reflects a portion of incoming damage back at the attacker before any mitigation.

name: Efficient Casting
description: Flat MP cost reduction on magic skills.

name: Arcane Recycling
description: A chance for a magic skill to cost nothing when cast.

name: Arcane Tempo
description: Flat cooldown reduction on all magic skills.
